description: This file implements x86-specific stack walking logic for crash dump analysis, including functions to recover call stacks using context, Windows frame info, CFI, and EBP-based methods.

classes.name: StackwalkerX86
classes.description: Class implementing x86-specific stack walking logic, including methods to retrieve caller frames using various strategies.

classes.name: StackFrameX86
classes.description: Represents a stack frame for x86 architecture, including context and validity flags.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Main method to retrieve the caller frame from a given call stack, using Windows, CFI, or EBP-based methods.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Returns a stack frame representing the current context.

methods.name: ReturnAddress
methods.description: Returns the return address stored in the current stack frame.
